observations_format: JSONL, one historical monthend bond observation per line
contract: See docs/pricing-methods.md; historical terms effective as of formation date, not today's contract.
return_convention: Decimal next-month total return including coupons and terminal cashflows. Missing termination payoff is an error, not a zero return.
risk_free: Decimal holding-month return; distinct from continuously compounded annual pricing rate.
factors_format: CSV date, MKT plus Carhart4/FF5/HXZ4/SY4/DHS3 named columns; decimal monthly factor returns, provenance and vintage required.
pricing_curve: Historical treasury spot/zero curve, interpolated to maturity, not assumed equivalent to bond YTM or Shibor.
private_storage: External user-authorized directory, excluded from Git and default packages. Manifest stores SHA256 for every data file.
prohibition: No current-only survivor universe, reconstructed future-known clauses, silent missing months, or redistribution of restricted raw data.
